"import json
import openmdao.api as om
import pycycle.api as pyc


def build_turbojet():
    prob = om.Problem()

    # Use TABULAR thermodynamic library with AIR_JETA_TAB_SPEC
    prob.model.add_subsystem(
        "flow", pyc.Cycle(thermo_method="TABULAR", thermo_data=pyc.AIR_JETA_TAB_SPEC),
    )

    # Cycle components
    indep = prob.model.add_subsystem("indep", om.IndepVarComp())
    # Inlet
    prob.model.add_subsystem("inlet", pyc.Inlet())
    # Compressor
    prob.model.add_subsystem("comp", pyc.AXI5())
    # Combustor
    prob.model.add_subsystem("burn", pyc.Combustor())
    # Turbine
    prob.model.add_subsystem("turb", pyc.LPT2269())
    # Nozzle
    prob.model.add_subsystem("noz", pyc.CDnozzle())
    # Shaft
    prob.model.add_subsystem("shaft", pyc.Shaft())

    # Connect flow path
    pyc.connect_flow(prob.model, "flow.s_in0", "inlet.Fl_I")
    pyc.connect_flow(prob.model, "inlet.Fl_O", "comp.Fl_I")
    pyc.connect_flow(prob.model, "comp.Fl_O", "burn.Fl_I")
    pyc.connect_flow(prob.model, "burn.Fl_O", "turb.Fl_I")
    pyc.connect_flow(prob.model, "turb.Fl_O", "noz.Fl_I")

    # Connect shaft
    prob.model.connect("comp.trq", "shaft.trq_in")
    prob.model.connect("turb.trq", "shaft.trq_out")

    # Set up inlet conditions - SL, MN~0, alt 0 ft
    prob.model.set_input_defaults("inlet.MN", 0.001)
    prob.model.set_input_defaults("inlet.alt", 0.0, units="ft")

    # Design targets
    prob.model.add_subsystem("fc", pyc.Fn_Static())
    prob.model.add_subsystem("wburn", pyc.WBurn())

    # Net thrust = nozzle thrust - inlet ram drag
    prob.model.connect("inlet.F_ram", "fc.F_ram")
    prob.model.connect("noz.Fg", "fc.Fg")

    # Fuel flow
    prob.model.connect("burn.Wfuel", "wburn.Wfuel")

    # Parameterize
    prob.model.add_subsystem("param", om.IndepVarComp())
    prob.model.connect("noz.PR", "param.PR_noz")
    prob.model.connect("burn.dPqP", "param.dPqP_burn")

    # Add balance
    prob.model.add_subsystem("bal", pyc.Balance())
    prob.model.connect("bal.HP", "comp.map.HP")
    prob.model.connect("bal.shaft_pwr", "shaft.pwr_out")
    prob.model.connect("bal.Nmech", "shaft.Nmech")

    # Add pcm solver
    prob.model.add_subsystem("pcm", pyc.PCM())

    # Solver setup
    prob.setup()

    # Set design point inputs
    prob["indep.OPR"] = 11.0
    prob["indep.T4"] = 2550.0  # degR
    prob["indep.Fn_target"] = 11000.0  # lbf
    prob["indep.W"] = 100.0  # initial guess
    prob["indep.turb_PR"] = 4.0
    prob["indep.comp_PR"] = 11.0
    prob["indep.burn_dPqP"] = 0.05
    prob["indep.noz_PR"] = 1.0
    prob["indep.Nmech"] = 8000.0

    return prob


def solve_design(prob):
    # Use Newton solver for the cycle
    prob.model.set_solver_print(level=-1)
    prob.model.nonlinear_solver = om.NewtonSolver()
    prob.model.nonlinear_solver.options["atol"] = 1e-8
    prob.model.nonlinear_solver.options["rtol"] = 1e-8
    prob.model.nonlinear_solver.options["maxiter"] = 50
    prob.model.nonlinear_solver.linesearch = om.ArmijoGoldsteinLS()
    prob.model.linear_solver = om.DirectSolver()

    # First solve the flow
    prob.run_model()


def main():
    prob = build_turbojet()

    # Need to set initial guesses for the design point
    # These will be set through the add_set_input calls

    # First, define design inputs
    prob["indep.OPR"] = 11.0
    prob["indep.T4"] = 2550.0
    prob["indep.Fn_target"] = 11000.0
    prob["indep.W"] = 100.0
    prob["indep.comp_PR"] = 11.0
    prob["indep.turb_PR"] = 4.0
    prob["indep.burn_dPqP"] = 0.05
    prob["indep.noz_PR"] = 1.0
    prob["indep.Nmech"] = 8000.0

    solve_design(prob)

    # Extract results
    Fn_lbf = float(prob["fc.Fn"])
    Wfuel = float(prob["wburn.Wfuel"])
    OPR = float(prob["indep.OPR"])
    W = float(prob["indep.W"])
    TSFC = Wfuel / Fn_lbf  # lbm/s / lbf

    result = {
        "Fn_lbf": Fn_lbf,
        "TSFC": TSFC,
        "OPR": OPR,
        "Wfuel_lbm_s": Wfuel,
    }

    with open("result.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump(result, f, "
